records.name: Stauer Lastminute
records.biography_en: Can move a mountain of cargo while being paid for a modest hill. He sorts HyperNorm cargo into useful and awaiting an approved use. A dissonant card is heavier than its paperwork and lighter than his worries. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Mehrarbeit wurde auf die Last umgelegt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can move a mountain of cargo while being paid for a modest hill.

records.name: Nieterin Nachklang
records.biography_en: Knows which noises are work and which are management. Her hammer fixes HyperNorm plates into one official shape. A dissonant card rings differently at each rivet and she secretly listens for the tune. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Nachhall ist keine bezahlte Tätigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows which noises are work and which are management.

records.name: Kranwart Pendelzeit
records.biography_en: Has never seen time move as slowly as a suspended load. His pulley lifts HyperNorm loads only after the waiting has been authorized. A dissonant card notes that gravity has not completed the form. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Last hängt. Die Zeit ebenfalls.

variant_notes.note_en: Has never seen time move as slowly as a suspended load.

records.name: Heizer Kohlenherz
records.biography_en: Feeds a machine that has never once asked how he is doing. He feeds the HyperNorm boiler with fuel marked necessary or insufficient. A dissonant card asks why the machine gets more rest than its keeper. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Maschine wurde versorgt. Der Mensch wird nachgereicht.

variant_notes.note_en: Feeds a machine that has never once asked how he is doing.

records.name: Dreher Rundlauf
records.biography_en: Finds comfort in the rare object that agrees to fit. His calipers admit HyperNorm parts only if they fit the prescribed gap. A dissonant card changes the gap instead of the part. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Passung entspricht vorübergehend der Wirklichkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds comfort in the rare object that agrees to fit.

records.name: Weberin Fadenhalt
records.biography_en: Keeps the thread when the whole shift loses the plot. Her shuttle weaves HyperNorm cloth in black or white. A dissonant card catches the thread between them and produces something surprisingly warm. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Faden hält. Der Schichtplan weniger.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the thread when the whole shift loses the plot.
